name: Emergency Response Australia
desc:
Welcome to Emergency Response Australia! 

Play as an Aussie Citizen, or join the force as General Duties, Highway Patrol, Public Order & Riot Squad, Tactical Operations Unit, Police Rescue, Fire & Rescue or as a Paramedic!

Live the criminal lifestyle, steal cars, rob petrol stations, cash ATMs or sell berries!

🔨Update Log: 22/10/2026
🧑 Added NPCs 
NPCs now spawn around the map. Be careful not to hit them, otherwise you will become wanted.
🎒  New Backpack Inventory
Improved inventory system, extra items now go to your backpack and it is now a lot easier to organize your inventory.
📱 New Mobile Controls UI

Mobile & Console is supported. Please report any bugs you find in our communications server.
